gameInstructions: Track the route in order: riverbank, open ground, then Jael’s tent.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Sisera left his chariot and fled on foot while Barak pursued the scattered army.

lines.speaker: israelite_scout
lines.text: Footprints leave the riverbank and cross the open ground toward the tents of Heber.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He came to the tent of Jael, believing there was peace between her household and King Jabin.

lines.speaker: jael
lines.text: Come, my lord, come right in. Do not be afraid.

gameSuccess: The trail leads from the abandoned chariot to Jael’s tent.
name: Ch.5 · Sisera Flees
